title: Reishi Spore Cloud
description: Lacquered reishi (lingzhi) growths quietly releasing fine cocoa-brown spores. Each is a lacquered cap sitting centred on a reddish-brown stipe (stem): grow it from a woody tree stump, from the branching deer-antler form (Ganoderma antler) whose stipe rises from a central tip, or both, with one to four of them placed at randomised spots along the ground. The spores stream off the pore surface under the cap as a fine, laminar flow that shears into layered sheets and curls on slow turbulence, backlit so the dense parts glow golden-brown like dust in a shaft of light. An optional iridescent glimmer gives a fraction of the spores an oil-slick sparkle. Emission, turbulence, rise-versus-settle, wind, conk count, growth form, iridescence, spore hue and glow are live; the growths can be hidden, and with the mic on each beat sends up a fresh puff.
